data.title: United States Oil Fund (USO) Hits 52-Week High as Supply Bottlenecks Intensify
data.description: Shares of the United States Oil Fund LP (NYSE: USO) surged to a new 52-week high Tuesday afternoon, tracking a sharp rally in benchmark crude futures as physical supply disruptions in the Middle East and tightening product markets heightened global supply concerns.

data.title: Oil Crisis Worsens, Diesel Hits Record High: Here's How to Trade It
data.description: Oil prices surged as Gulf attacks disrupted Saudi infrastructure, threatening supplies; Brent topped $107 and U.S. diesel hit record highs.

data.description: Coinbase fell over 6% as CLARITY Act odds sank after Republicans rejected a Democratic proposal ahead of a crucial Senate vote.

data.title: Amazon Stock Slides: What's Happening?
data.description: Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) shares are slipping Tuesday along with the broader tech sector as investors brace for Wednesday's Federal Reserve rate decision, with markets pricing in a rate hike.
